Return the indices of the k largest scores ordered by descending score, ties broken by the smaller index first. If k exceeds the number of scores, pad the result with 0 values to length k. k = 0 returns [].
reference:
def solve(value):
    scores = value["scores"]
    k = value["k"]
    idx = sorted(range(len(scores)), key=lambda i: (-scores[i], i))
    return [idx[i] if i < len(idx) else 0 for i in range(k)]
